---
title: "A widget from Jupyter"
format:
  emiljs:
    embed-resources: true
jupyter: python3
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        # the markup and its inline script survive, blank lines and all
        - ['#py-widget', 'script']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['getElementById\("py-widget"\)']
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import HTML
HTML("""<div id="py-widget">before</div>

<script>
document.getElementById("py-widget").textContent = "script ran";
</script>""")
```
